146	                raise RuntimeError("WebSocket 握手失败：连接已关闭")
147	            head += chunk
148	        if b" 101 " not in head.split(b"\r\n", 1)[0]:
149	            raise RuntimeError(f"WebSocket 握手被拒绝：{head[:120]!r}")
150	        self._buf = head.split(b"\r\n\r\n", 1)[1]
151	        self._send_lock = threading.Lock()
152	        self._cond = threading.Condition()
153	        self._results = {}
154	        self._events = []
155	        self._next_id = 0
156	        self._closed = False
157	        self._reader = threading.Thread(target=self._read_loop, daemon=True)
158	        self._reader.start()
159	
160	    def _send_text(self, text):
161	        payload = text.encode("utf-8")
162	        mask = os.urandom(4)
163	        n = len(payload)
164	        prefix = bytearray([0x81])
165	        if n < 126:
166	            prefix.append(0x80 | n)
167	        elif n < 65536:
168	            prefix.append(0x80 | 126)
169	            prefix += struct.pack(">H", n)
170	        else:
171	            prefix.append(0x80 | 127)
172	            prefix += struct.pack(">Q", n)
173	        masked = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(payload))
174	        with self._send_lock:
175	            self.sock.sendall(bytes(prefix) + mask + masked)
176	
177	    def _read_exact(self, n):
178	        while len(self._buf) < n:
179	            chunk = self.sock.recv(65536)
180	            if not chunk:
181	                raise OSError("连接关闭")
182	            self._buf += chunk
183	        out, self._buf = self._buf[:n], self._buf[n:]
184	        return out
185	
186	    def _read_message(self):
187	        chunks = []
188	        b0, b1 = self._read_exact(2)
189	        fin = bool(b0 & 0x80)
190	        opcode = b0 & 0x0F
191	        n = b1 & 0x7F
192	        if n == 126:
193	            n = struct.unpack(">H", self._read_exact(2))[0]
194	        elif n == 127:
195	            n = struct.unpack(">Q", self._read_exact(8))[0]
196	        data = self._read_exact(n) if n else b""
197	        if not fin:  # 分片帧（CDP 一般不发送），拼到 FIN 为止
198	            while True:
199	                c0, c1 = self._read_exact(2)
200	                cn = c1 & 0x7F
201	                if cn == 126:
202	                    cn = struct.unpack(">H", self._read_exact(2))[0]
203	                elif cn == 127:
204	                    cn = struct.unpack(">Q", self._read_exact(8))[0]
205	                data += self._read_exact(cn) if cn else b""
206	                if c0 & 0x80:
207	                    break
208	        if opcode == 0x9:  # ping -> pong
209	            with self._send_lock:
210	                self.sock.sendall(b"\x8A\x00")
211	            return None
212	        if opcode == 0x8:  # close
213	            raise OSError("收到 close 帧")
214	        if opcode != 0x1:
215	            return None
216	        return json.loads(data.decode("utf-8"))
217	
218	    def _read_loop(self):
219	        while not self._closed:
220	            try:
221	                message = self._read_message()
222	            except OSError:
223	                break
224	            if message is None:
225	                continue
226	            with self._cond:
227	                if "id" in message:
228	                    self._results[message["id"]] = message
229	                else:
230	                    self._events.append(message)
231	                self._cond.notify_all()
232	
233	    def call(self, method, params=None, *, session_id=None, timeout=15):
234	        with self._cond:
235	            self._next_id += 1
236	            msg_id = self._next_id
237	        message = {"id": msg_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}
238	        if session_id:
239	            message["sessionId"] = session_id
240	        self._send_text(json.dumps(message))
241	        end = time.time() + timeout
242	        with self._cond:
243	            while msg_id not in self._results:
244	                remaining = end - time.time()
245	                if remaining <= 0:
246	                    raise TimeoutError(f"CDP 调用超时：{method}")
247	                self._cond.wait(remaining)
248	            result = self._results.pop(msg_id)
249	        if "error" in result:
250	            raise RuntimeError(f"CDP 错误（{method}）：{result['error']}")
251	        return result.get("result", {})
252	
253	    def drain_events(self, timeout=0.1):
254	        """等待并取出缓存的全部事件（命令响应不会混入）。"""
255	        end = time.time() + timeout
256	        with self._cond:
257	            while not self._events and time.time() < end:
258	                self._cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))
259	            events, self._events = self._events, []
260	            return events
261	
262	    def push_events(self, events):
263	        """把不属于调用方的事件放回队列，供其它等待者继续观察。"""
264	        with self._cond:
265	            self._events.extend(events)
266	            self._cond.notify_all()
267	
268	    def close(self):
269	        self._closed = True
270	        with self._send_lock:
271	            try:
272	                self.sock.close()
273	            except OSError:
274	                pass

453	class ChromePage:
454	    def __init__(self, ws, target_id, session_id):
455	        self.ws = ws
456	        self.target_id = target_id
457	        self.session = session_id
458	        self.held = []          # 被挂起的详情 GET
459	        self.observed = []      # 观察到的全部 /api/surveys 请求（method, path）
460	        self._held_cond = threading.Condition()
461	        self._pumping = False
462	
463	    def prepare(self):
464	        self.call("Page.enable")
465	        self.call("Runtime.enable")
466	        self.call("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", {"source": TEST_HELPERS})
467	        # 后台持续运转 CDP 事件：拦截开启期间，只有读取详情的 GET
468	        # （/api/surveys/{id}，编辑加载与重试都走它）会被挂起；列表 GET、静态
469	        # 资源以及任何 POST/PUT 都立即放行，否则切换到的首页会被自己的请求饿死。
470	        self._pumping = True
471	        threading.Thread(target=self._event_loop, daemon=True).start()
472	
473	    def _event_loop(self):
474	        while self._pumping:
475	            events = self.ws.drain_events(0.2)
476	            passthrough = []
477	            for event in events:
478	                # 多个标签页的事件泵共用一条 WebSocket：只处理属于本会话的
479	                # 事件，否则旧标签页收尾时会用失效 session 错误放行新标签页
480	                # 挂起的请求，或把新页面的 requestPaused 吞掉导致永久挂起。
481	                if event.get("sessionId") != self.session:
482	                    passthrough.append(event)
483	                    continue
484	                if event.get("method") == "Fetch.requestPaused":
485	                    params = event["params"]
486	                    request = params["request"]
487	                    path = urlsplit(request["url"]).path
488	                    with self._held_cond:
489	                        self.observed.append((request["method"], path))
490	                    if request["method"] == "GET" and DETAIL_GET_RE.match(path):
491	                        with self._held_cond:
492	                            self.held.append(params)
493	                            self._held_cond.notify_all()
494	                        continue
495	                    try:
496	                        self.call("Fetch.continueRequest",
497	                                  {"requestId": params["requestId"]})
498	                    except Exception:
499	                        pass
500	                else:
501	                    passthrough.append(event)
502	            if passthrough:
503	                self.ws.push_events(passthrough)
504	
505	    def call(self, method, params=None, timeout=15):
506	        return self.ws.call(method, params, session_id=self.session, timeout=timeout)
507	
508	    def close(self):
509	        self._pumping = False
510	        try:
511	            self.ws.call("Target.closeTarget", {"targetId": self.target_id}, timeout=5)
512	        except Exception:
513	            pass
514	
515	    def eval(self, expression, timeout=10):
516	        result = self.call("Runtime.evaluate", {
517	            "expression": expression,
518	            "returnByValue": True,
519	            "awaitPromise": True,
520	        }, timeout=timeout)
521	        if "exceptionDetails" in result:
522	            details = result["exceptionDetails"]
523	            raise AssertionError(f"页面脚本异常：{json.dumps(details, ensure_ascii=False)[:500]}")
524	        return result.get("result", {}).get("value")

526	    def t(self, name, *args):
527	        arg_s = ", ".join(json.dumps(a, ensure_ascii=False) for a in args)
528	        return self.eval(f"window.__t.{name}({arg_s})")

532	    def open(self, url):
533	        queued = self.ws.drain_events(0)
534	        if queued:
535	            self.ws.push_events(queued)
536	        self.call("Page.navigate", {"url": url})
537	        end = time.time() + 10
538	        while time.time() < end:
539	            # 只取本页的加载完成事件；其它事件（尤其 Fetch.requestPaused）
540	            # 必须放回队列交给后台事件泵处理，否则该请求会永久暂停。
541	            events = self.ws.drain_events(0.2)
542	            mine, others = [], []
543	            for event in events:
544	                if (event.get("sessionId") == self.session
545	                        and event.get("method") == "Page.loadEventFired"):
546	                    mine.append(event)
547	                else:
548	                    others.append(event)
549	            if others:
550	                self.ws.push_events(others)
551	            if mine:
552	                return
553	        raise AssertionError(f"页面加载超时：{url}")

555	    def wait_for(self, expression, timeout=10):
556	        end = time.time() + timeout
557	        while time.time() < end:
558	            value = self.eval(expression)
559	            if value:
560	                return value
561	            time.sleep(0.15)
562	        raise AssertionError(f"等待页面条件超时：{expression}")

564	    def settle(self, seconds=0.7):
565	        """让微任务/异步回调有机会落地。"""
566	        time.sleep(seconds)

570	    def hold_gets(self):
571	        """挂起所有 GET /api/surveys/{id}；其它请求由后台事件循环立即放行。"""
572	        with self._held_cond:
573	            self.held = []

579	        end = time.time() + timeout
580	        with self._held_cond:
581	            while not self.held and time.time() < end:
582	                self._held_cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))
583	            if self.held:

591	    def fulfill_json(self, paused, status, payload):
592	        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")

594	            "requestId": paused["requestId"],

597	                                 "value": "application/json; charset=utf-8"}],
598	            "body": base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii"),
599	        })

602	        self.call("Fetch.failRequest",
603	                  {"requestId": paused["requestId"], "errorReason": "Failed"})
604	
605	    def stop_holding(self):
606	        try:
607	            self.call("Fetch.disable", timeout=5)
608	        except Exception:
609	            pass
610	
611	    def observed_requests(self):
612	        with self._held_cond:
613	            return list(self.observed)

618	        return self.eval(LOAD_JS)

621	        return self.eval(SNAPSHOT_JS)
622

624	        return self.eval(DETAIL_JS)

434	class ChromePage:
435	    def __init__(self, ws, target_id, session_id):
436	        self.ws = ws
437	        self.target_id = target_id
438	        self.session = session_id
439	        self.held_lists = []    # 被挂起的列表读取（GET /api/surveys，按到达顺序）
440	        self.held_posts = []    # 被挂起的创建请求（POST /api/surveys，按到达顺序）
441	        self._held_cond = threading.Condition()
442	        self._pumping = False
443	
444	    def prepare(self):
445	        self.call("Page.enable")
446	        self.call("Runtime.enable")
447	        self.call("Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument", {"source": TEST_HELPERS})
448	        # 后台持续运转 CDP 事件：拦截开启期间，除“列表读取”和“创建请求”外的
449	        # 请求（详情 GET、PUT、静态资源等）必须立即放行，否则页面自己的其它
450	        # 请求会被挂起饿死；被挂起的两类请求按到达顺序收集，交给测试决定
451	        # 每一次何时、以何种结果返回。
452	        self._pumping = True
453	        self._pump_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._event_loop, daemon=True)
454	        self._pump_thread.start()
455	
456	    def _event_loop(self):
457	        while self._pumping:
458	            try:
459	                events = self.ws.drain_events(0.2)
460	            except OSError:
461	                break
462	            passthrough = []
463	            for event in events:
464	                # 同一根 WebSocket 承载着浏览器里所有标签页的事件：只处理属于
465	                # 本会话的，其它会话的事件原样放回，交给对应页面的循环处理，
466	                # 绝不能按本页会话误放行/误收集（否则被挂起的请求会永远卡住）。
467	                if event.get("sessionId") not in (None, self.session):
468	                    passthrough.append(event)
469	                    continue
470	                if event.get("method") == "Fetch.requestPaused":
471	                    params = event["params"]
472	                    request = params["request"]
473	                    path = urlsplit(request["url"]).path
474	                    if request["method"] == "GET" and path == "/api/surveys":
475	                        with self._held_cond:
476	                            self.held_lists.append(params)
477	                            self._held_cond.notify_all()
478	                        continue
479	                    if request["method"] == "POST" and path == "/api/surveys":
480	                        with self._held_cond:
481	                            self.held_posts.append(params)
482	                            self._held_cond.notify_all()
483	                        continue
484	                    try:
485	                        self.call("Fetch.continueRequest",
486	                                  {"requestId": params["requestId"]})
487	                    except Exception:
488	                        pass
489	                else:
490	                    passthrough.append(event)
491	            if passthrough:
492	                self.ws.push_events(passthrough)
493	
494	    def call(self, method, params=None, timeout=15):
495	        return self.ws.call(method, params, session_id=self.session, timeout=timeout)
496	
497	    def close(self):
498	        # 先停掉并等尽本页的后台事件循环：它与下一页的循环共用同一根
499	        # WebSocket，若不及时退出会把新页被挂起的请求抢走（按旧会话处理），
500	        # 造成后续测试莫名超时。
501	        self._pumping = False
502	        self._pump_thread.join(timeout=5)
503	        try:
504	            self.ws.call("Target.closeTarget", {"targetId": self.target_id}, timeout=5)
505	        except Exception:
506	            pass

508	    def eval(self, expression, timeout=10):
509	        result = self.call("Runtime.evaluate", {
510	            "expression": expression,
511	            "returnByValue": True,
512	            "awaitPromise": True,
513	        }, timeout=timeout)
514	        if "exceptionDetails" in result:
515	            details = result["exceptionDetails"]
516	            raise AssertionError(f"页面脚本异常：{json.dumps(details, ensure_ascii=False)[:500]}")
517	        return result.get("result", {}).get("value")
518	
519	    def t(self, name, *args):
520	        arg_s = ", ".join(json.dumps(a, ensure_ascii=False) for a in args)
521	        return self.eval(f"window.__t.{name}({arg_s})")

525	    def open(self, url):
526	        self.ws.drain_events(0)
527	        self.call("Page.navigate", {"url": url})
528	        end = time.time() + 10
529	        while time.time() < end:
530	            leftover = []
531	            batch = self.ws.drain_events(0.2)
532	            for i, event in enumerate(batch):
533	                if event.get("method") == "Page.loadEventFired":
534	                    # 拦截已开启时，导航期间就可能有请求被挂起（首页的首次列表
535	                    # 读取）：不属于本方法的事件——包括同一批里排在加载事件
536	                    # 之后的——都必须放回队列，交给后台事件循环处理，否则被
537	                    # 挂起的请求会永远卡住。
538	                    self.ws.push_events(leftover + batch[i + 1:])
539	                    return
540	                leftover.append(event)
541	            self.ws.push_events(leftover)
542	        raise AssertionError(f"页面加载超时：{url}")

544	    def wait_for(self, expression, timeout=10):
545	        end = time.time() + timeout
546	        while time.time() < end:
547	            value = self.eval(expression)
548	            if value:
549	                return value
550	            time.sleep(0.15)
551	        raise AssertionError(f"等待页面条件超时：{expression}")

553	    def settle(self, seconds=0.6):
554	        """让后台拦截循环、微任务与异步回调有机会落地。"""
555	        time.sleep(seconds)

557	    def wait_for_listing_text(self, substring, timeout=8):
558	        """轮询列表区域，直到其文本包含 substring，返回列表快照。"""
559	        end = time.time() + timeout
560	        last = None
561	        while time.time() < end:
562	            listing = self.listing()
563	            last = listing
564	            if listing["present"] and substring in (listing["text"] or ""):
565	                return listing
566	            time.sleep(0.12)

571	
572	    def hold_reads(self):
573	        """挂起 GET/POST /api/surveys；详情 GET、PUT 等由后台事件循环立即放行。"""
574	        with self._held_cond:
575	            self.held_lists = []
576	            self.held_posts = []
577	        self.call("Fetch.enable", {
578	            "patterns": [{"urlPattern": "*api/surveys*", "requestStage": "Request"}]})

580	    def held_list(self, index, timeout=8):
581	        """取出（不移除）按到达顺序第 index 个被挂起的列表读取。"""
582	        end = time.time() + timeout
583	        with self._held_cond:
584	            while len(self.held_lists) <= index and time.time() < end:
585	                self._held_cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))
586	            if len(self.held_lists) > index:
587	                return self.held_lists[index]
588	        raise AssertionError(f"第 {index + 1} 次列表读取未发出（GET 未被挂起）")
589	
590	    def list_read_count(self):
591	        with self._held_cond:
592	            return len(self.held_lists)

594	    def pop_held_post(self, timeout=8):
595	        """取出（并移除）最早一个被挂起的创建请求。"""
596	        end = time.time() + timeout
597	        with self._held_cond:
598	            while not self.held_posts and time.time() < end:
599	                self._held_cond.wait(max(0.0, end - time.time()))
600	            if self.held_posts:
601	                return self.held_posts.pop(0)
602	        raise AssertionError("创建请求未发出（POST 未被挂起）")

612	            "requestId": paused["requestId"],
613	            "responseCode": status,
614	            "responseHeaders": [{"name": "Content-Type",

616	            "body": base64.b64encode(body).decode("ascii"),

content.text:
已修正打开问卷详情时对异常返回内容的处理。

## 问题根因

`renderDetail`（`app.py`）原先对成功状态的 200 响应完全不设防：`resp.json()` 与正文结构都在同一个 try 里，且解析后直接使用 `survey.id/title/questions/options`。于是：

- 正文不是合法 JSON → 解析异常被 `catch` 误当成网络错误，或直接抛在渲染阶段，页面永久停在"加载中…"；
- 缺 `questions` → 访问 `.length` 抛错，卡加载；
- 题目结构畸形（缺 `options`、题型不受支持、`required` 非布尔等）→ 渲染半份详情，且 `q.type === "single_choice" ? ... : "文本题"` 会把任何不支持的题型标成文本题；
- 编号与地址不一致也照常展示，编辑入口指向错误问卷。

## 修改内容（`app.py`，前端内嵌页面）

1. **拆分读取阶段**：网络失败（fetch reject）→ 沿用现有 `详情加载失败：…`（无状态码）；真实 404 → 才显示"问卷 #id 不存在"；其他非成功状态 → 沿用 `详情加载失败（HTTP 状态码）…`。
2. **JSON 解析单独成段**：200 但正文不可解析时，明确提示"详情加载失败，返回内容无法用于展示。"，不再卡加载。
3. **复用统一结构门槛**：把编辑页的 `editableSurveyFromRead` 泛化为 `surveyFromRead`，详情与编辑共用。校验：单份对象、`id` 与当前地址严格相等（`1 !== "1"`）、标题/说明为字符串、题目为数组；每题须有字符串标题、题型仅 `text`/`single_choice`、`required` 为布尔、`options` 为字符串数组，单选至少两项、文本题不得带选项。任一不符即**整份**判失败——不跳过题目、不补默认、不用 `!!` 转换、不渲染任何残缺说明/题目/编辑链接，只保留"← 返回首页"。
4. **合法形态保持原义**：空说明仍显示"（无说明）"，空题目数组的旧记录仍显示零道题与两个编辑补齐入口；中文/引号/换行、必填选填、题目次序不变。晚到结果仍由 `view !== activeView` 丢弃；打开详情只读不写。

## 验证

新增 `test_detail_load_failure.py`（真实 Chrome + CDP 挂起详情 GET，22 个用例）：加载态、真实/夹带正文的 404、500/502/503（错误 JSON/纯文本/空体/夹带完整问卷）、网络中断、非法 JSON、顶层非对象、编号缺失/不一致、各类字段与题目畸形、半份正常半份畸形、不支持题型不得标文本题、合法问卷逐字段展示、空说明、空题目旧记录、从首页链接打开、失败后返回首页、以及离开详情后晚到的成功/404/500/正文失败全部忽略。

全部通过：新增 22 项 + 既有套件共 **119 项全部 OK**，无回归。
